readyLocalRequires: actual native generation and selected device
HELLO write completed + matching generation/sequence/opcode ACK status0 with valid 8B hello/version1/caps15
GET_STATE write completed + matching generation/sequence/opcode ACK status0 with valid 10B device state
requestInvariants: both GATT write and correlated application ACK required
no mutation auto replay after timeout/disconnect
sequence exhaustion requires reconnect, no wrap in same generation
HELLO MAC not assumed equal to USB or BLE MAC before firmware review
startLocalCompletion: Only ACK confirms command acceptance; subsequent validated GET_STATE and old firmware screen contract determine actual local/tutorial state. No hardcoded successful screen mapping yet.
stateRevision: UInt16 device UI revision only; modular delta in (0,32768) considered newer; not pet-save revision or account identity.
newDataAndPeerPorts: absent until old firmware source and negotiated support verified; no numeric opcodes/object kinds allocated in this draft
durableEventOrdering: phone checks petId/type and applies event once in complete local save transaction
phone persists result and dedup receipt
phone transmits terminal ACK only after persistence
device persists queue removal or rejection quarantine
phone pushes committed view; device persistence receipt gates synced UI
storageFailurePolicy: no terminal ACK; keep event eligible, show local error; not semantic rejection
realEncounterPolicy: NPC/BroadcastChannel/parseCode check alone cannot create verified peer receipt; original rules applied once only after actual required peer/input confirmation and local persistence
constraints: no new key creation or permission grant in analysis
reconnectException: disconnected->connecting only for a bounded foreground reconnect lease from the same explicitly selected device with permissions still valid; no startup auto-connect or mutation replay.
requestIdMeaning: UI requestId is a local trace only, not an existing firmware durable idempotency key.

sharedUuidVariants.classic: type/length/payload social protocol, no BJ20 assumption
sharedUuidVariants.readiness: Strict HELLO/ACK detects supported variant; UUID match alone never suffices

dataCloudBoundary: V2 private EVENT/PET/LIFE/TIME/precise ACK require signed session; no cloud-free capability is inferred or advertised by current basic adapter.
